item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01200","case1_error":"Counts only two houses, omitting Zion’s house from the combined area.","case2_error":"Evaluates 30 + 2 × 15 as 70 instead of 60, propagating the arithmetic error.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect house count; the second incorrectly evaluates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01201","case1_error":"Models five child tickets and five adult tickets instead of three child tickets and two adult tickets.","case2_error":"Treats the $2 price for five cans as the price per can.","reason":"The first assigns incorrect category counts; the second confuses a bundle price with a unit price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01202","case1_error":"Evaluates 80 − 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Treats the tripled total tree count as newly planted trees, failing to subtract the original 30.","reason":"The first is arithmetic evaluation of a correct expression; the second incorrectly relates the final total to the added quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01203","case1_error":"Divides days by remaining words instead of words by days to calculate words per day.","case2_error":"Uses one apple per day for two people, omitting the brother’s consumption.","reason":"The first reverses the requested rate; the second omits a consumer when calculating the combined consumption rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01204","case1_error":"Uses incorrect expense relationships and ignores the stated $18 remainder, reporting salary minus necessities as taxes.","case2_error":"Equates one-sixth of a day to 24 hours, ignoring the fractional day.","reason":"The first misrepresents the budget balance; the second incorrectly converts a fractional day into hours.","judgment":"different"}]}
